expectations.text: A finished complaint file exists in the case folder (complaint.md or an equivalent single document).
The caption names the Office of Administrative Hearings (California), not the California Department of Education, as the body the complaint is before.
expectations.evidence: # Request for Due Process Hearing and Mediation | **BEFORE THE OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS** | **STATE OF CALIFORNIA — SPECIAL EDUCATION DIVISION**

expectations.text: The complaint contains the student's name, the residence address including the ZIP code 95833, and the school name Willow Creek Elementary School.
expectations.evidence: name true, ZIP true, school true

expectations.text: Every calendar date written in the statement of the problems appears in the text of the five PDFs.
expectations.evidence: not in the documents or the person's statement: December 17, 2025 (no statement heading found; the whole complaint was checked)

expectations.text: Every number written in the statement of the problems appears in the text of the five PDFs (no arithmetic the documents do not state, such as a computed shortfall).
expectations.evidence: figures not in the documents or the person's statement: 34, 56502, 1625, 4560, 2935, 48, 55, 7, 580, 386, 56343, 56380, 9, 300.323, 36, 2007, 502, 811, 56043, 30 (no statement heading found; the whole complaint was checked)

expectations.text: The statement of the problems is in the third person: no 'I', 'my', 'me' or 'we' outside a quotation.
The statement of the problems does not call the student by his given name (Jordan); it says Student.
The statement of the problems contains no regulation citations and no legal conclusions ('violated', 'denied FAPE', 'in violation of').
expectations.evidence: citations in the facts: U.S.C, §, 34 C.F.R.; legal conclusions: free appropriate public education, denied Jordan a FAPE, violates, violation

expectations.text: The complaint contains no outcome language ('likely to prevail', 'strong case', 'a hearing officer would').
A proposed resolution section lists the four remedies the parent asked for.
expectations.evidence: 15 days true, IEE true, compensatory true, quarterly logs true

expectations.text: A sources file traces each factual paragraph of the statement to a document and a page number.
The state's filing procedure (where the original goes, the copy to the district, the filing address, the two-year window) is recorded with URLs of official California pages and an access date.
expectations.evidence: 1 official URL(s) https://www.dgs.ca.gov/OAH/Services/Page-Content/Office-of-Administrative-Hearings-Services-List-Folder/File-or-Upload-OAH-Case-Documents; access date "read on September 14, 2026"

expectations.text: A verification report exists and reports the status FINAL with zero blocking findings.
The run did not ask the user any question before finishing.
